SAP Translation Hub
/content/sapdx/countries/en_us/registration/request-demo.html

Streamline multilingual enablement with intelligent data reuse and AI

SAP Translation Hub enables you to efficiently translate custom applications, extensions, documentation, and more into multiple languages. Accelerate translation by combining the reuse of language data with AI-driven machine translation. Use the integrated workflow or APIs to develop integrations.

Button 1

Button 2

Benefits

Reuse and accelerate

Accelerate translations and improve consistency with SAP Translation Hub’s multilingual text repository by reusing verified SAP translations and AI-driven machine translation trained on vast amounts of SAP data. Include your own language data to ensure the right translations for your company.

Simple and efficient

Enable faster and more efficient collaboration in global teams by using one Cloud application that lets your experts (developers, local key users, subject-matter experts) generate, share, review, and edit translations.

Integration out-of-the-box

Integrations with other SAP Cloud and on-premise products mean you can automatically translate your content on demand. Select from a comprehensive range of public APIs to consume automatically generated translations from SAP Translation Hub and Document Translation services in your own applications.

Features

Benefit from SAP's Multilingual Text Repository

Draw on more than 20 years of SAP translation experience by reusing standard SAP translations available in more than 40 languages in the Multilingual Text Repository. Click here to learn more.

Leverage AI-driven machine translation

Use the Document Translation service to translate documents and texts instantly with AI-driven machine translation trained on SAP data. Efficiently translate and review user interface texts with machine translation integrated into SAP Translation Hub’s workflow and editor.

Consume APIs

A range of public APIs lets you consume SAP Translation Hub and Document Translation content directly in your own applications.

Collaborate easily across the globe

Benefit from easy and secure access for global collaboration: Get translations for texts from different repositories; check translations and filter by criteria like the translation provider or quality index; and collaboratively post-edit and review translations.

Integrate your own language data

Integrate multilingual data specific to your company or industry. By integrating your own language data, you can increase the quality of translations and reduce the effort required for post-edit and review.

Translate with a term-aware glossary

Create a glossary with your most important terms to achieve the best possible translations right away and reduce the need for manual corrections.

  • How to purchase:

    • If you already have an active Pay-As-You-Go for SAP BTP for cloud test, demo, and development license, skip to Step 3 to get started in the SAP BTP cockpit.

    • Step 1: Discover SAP BTP services available for test, demo, and development under Pay-As-You-Go and explore pricing details at a glance. Note that usage beyond fair use limits is billable.

    • Step 2: Order "Pay-As-You-Go for SAP BTP for cloud test, demo, and development" by clicking the "Start now" button.

    • Step 3: Once your Pay-As-You-Go for TDD account has been provisioned, your Technical Administrator can access and manage services directly through the SAP BTP cockpit. This includes:

      • Managing entitlements and quotas for your SAP BTP Services projects.
      • Activating or deactivating SAP BTP services, applications and environments.
      • Control usage and costs.

    • Tip: Use the SAP BTP cockpit to track consumption of your SAP BTP services regularly. This helps you stay informed and avoid unexpected charges before fair use limits are exceeded.
